import pandas as pd

beneficiaries = pd.read_csv(beneficiaries_path)
payments = pd.read_excel(payments_path, sheet_name='Disbursements', header=4)

# Ensure columns
# Clean Beneficiary ID
beneficiaries['Beneficiary ID'] = beneficiaries['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
beneficiary_ids = set(beneficiaries['Beneficiary ID'].unique())

# Clean payments
payments['Beneficiary ID'] = payments['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
payments['Status'] = payments['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

# Filter status paid and beneficiary exists
mask = (payments['Status'] == 'paid') & (payments['Beneficiary ID'].isin(beneficiary_ids))
filtered = payments[mask]

unique_paid_beneficiaries = set(filtered['Beneficiary ID'].unique())

total_beneficiaries = len(beneficiary_ids)
num_paid = len(unique_paid_beneficiaries)

percentage = (num_paid / total_beneficiaries * 100) if total_beneficiaries else 0
print('total_beneficiaries', total_beneficiaries)
print('unique_paid', num_paid)
print('percentage', percentage)

# Also check for duplicate beneficiary IDs in CSV
print('duplicate beneficiary IDs in CSV?', beneficiaries['Beneficiary ID'].duplicated().any())
